claims.title: Dilmun settlement on Failaka
claims.summary: Failaka island became a flourishing outpost of the Bronze Age Dilmun trading culture, with a town, temple, palace, and one of the largest concentrations of Dilmun seals known.

claims.title: Alexander's fleet names the island Ikaros
claims.summary: During the exploration of the Gulf by Alexander the Great's navy, the admiral Nearchus is credited with naming Failaka 'Ikaros' after an Aegean island.
